title: Microsoft 365 Mail Hygiene & Anti-Spam — EOP / Defender for Office 365
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Tune M365 mail hygiene so threats stop and good mail flows
problem: Default mail hygiene lets phishing through and quarantines legitimate mail — both erode trust. This solution configures and tunes Microsoft 365 mail hygiene: Exchange Online Protection (EOP) anti-spam, anti-malware, and connection/spoof filtering, plus Defender for Office 365 anti-phishing, Safe Links, and Safe Attachments where licensed — with quarantine policy, allow/block management, and the recommended (preset/Standard-Strict) baselines — so threats are blocked and false positives are minimized.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the hygiene stack: EOP anti-spam/malware/spoof, Defender for Office 365 (anti-phish, Safe Links/Attachments), preset security policies, and quarantine.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + EOP/Defender for Office 365 licensing, admin roles, DNS/auth, pilot group).

Implementation Guide — apply the baseline (preset or Standard/Strict), tune anti-spam/malware/anti-phish, configure Safe Links/Attachments, set quarantine + allow/block policy, and validate with test messages — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (threats blocked, false-positive rate low, quarantine reviewed) plus Best Practices for ongoing hygiene tuning and reporting.
short: Configure and tune Microsoft 365 mail hygiene — EOP anti-spam/malware/spoof + Defender for Office 365 anti-phish/Safe Links/Safe Attachments, preset baselines, and quarantine/allow-block policy — so threats are blocked and false positives minimized. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
